operations.title: Declared observation profile and normalized cells
operations.purpose: Validate a complete finite supplied-state observation record without inferring measured sensors.

operations.title: Observation refinement with a splitting counterexample
operations.purpose: Compare equivalence relations; a finer left partition must never identify a pair separated on the right.

operations.title: Common refinement by paired labels
operations.purpose: Intersect the two indiscernibility relations and preserve every resulting nonempty cell.

operations.title: Least common coarsening of observation cells
operations.purpose: Join equivalence relations through their transitive closure; direct pair union alone is insufficient.

operations.title: Partial block map with an explicit ambiguity witness
operations.purpose: Map a left cell to one right cell only when every member agrees; keep split cells unresolved.

operations.title: Certain membership under declared observations
operations.purpose: Return the union of complete observation cells contained in the target set.

operations.title: Possible membership under declared observations
operations.purpose: Return the union of observation cells meeting the target set, without interpreting possibility as probability.

operations.title: Undecided rough membership region
operations.purpose: Keep possible-but-not-certain states explicit; an empty target and the whole universe have no boundary.

operations.title: Pairs distinguished by an observation partition
operations.purpose: Enumerate unordered state pairs with different declared observations, without a privacy guarantee.

operations.title: Choices common to each observation cell
operations.purpose: Intersect supplied per-state action labels inside a cell; statewise availability need not yield a common action.

operations.title: Lost and gained distinctions between partitions
operations.purpose: Represent both directions of an observation change; do not assume the right partition is a coarsening.

operations.title: Certain and possible membership after refinement
operations.purpose: Compare lower and upper approximations before and after the common refinement with a second observation.

operations.title: Existential quotient-transition relation
operations.purpose: Retain which cell-to-cell edges have a concrete witness; adjacent witnesses need not compose into one path.

operations.title: Concrete realization of a supplied abstract word
operations.purpose: Search one contiguous concrete path and preserve every reachable frontier, including the first empty one.

operations.title: Finite observation language at an exact horizon
operations.purpose: Enumerate complete observation words of exactly the declared length, not unbounded temporal behavior.

operations.title: Abstract words without a concrete realization
operations.purpose: Compare quotient words with concrete observation words and retain the lexicographically first spurious witness.

operations.title: Minimum-cardinality finite feature covers
operations.purpose: Find every smallest subset of supplied features distinguishing all declared goal pairs.

operations.title: Minimum declared feature cost with all ties
operations.purpose: Minimize positive integer model costs across distinguishing subsets; these units are not money or real procurement.

operations.title: Missing evidence for an observation-based claim
operations.purpose: Role labels and finite fixtures cannot establish real sensor, empirical, production or affected-user evidence.

operations.title: Authority reservation for an observation model
operations.purpose: Keep deployment, cultural ratification, personhood, rights allocation and Stage 20 unavailable to synthetic labels.
